definition.title: Catch the users of a tool that is shutting down
definition.description: Weekly or on demand: find a nearby tool that is shutting down, dropping its free plan, repricing or relicensing, check that your product can honestly take its users, and get a dated migration kit with their export mapped to your product, the import gap, and ready inputs for the migration page and the importer. Quiet weeks end with a short watch list.

prerequisites.reason: The onboarding plan names the product, its buyers, its competitors and the hard no's a migration page must respect.
The Feature map's features are the core tasks a moving user needs covered; Fit is scored against them.
The Code map shows which import paths and file formats the product already accepts, which sets Portability.
When the keyword plan lists alternative-to or export-from searches for the moving tool, their observed demand is cited; otherwise demand is reported as unmeasured.

known_event.title: A shutdown or price change you already know about (optional)
known_event.description: Paste the announcement link or describe it. It is checked like any other event, not taken on trust.
